industry_epoch_map.statement: The initial cutoff-safe panel contains four listed-consolidated issuers with recorded FY2016 statutory reports spanning room air conditioning, refrigeration/washing and multi-category appliance systems; this is a source-coverage state, not a peer-performance ranking.

At the later cutoff, FY2017 statutory reports remain available for the diversified appliance, refrigeration/washing and dual white-goods issuer boundaries; cross-company comparison still requires product, customer, channel and accounting-boundary matching.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Seasonal room-air-conditioner demand reaches manufacturers through product mix, manufacturing, channel and installation interfaces.
mechanism_arenas.customer_task: Household cooling and replacement demand served through distributors, retail and installation systems.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Product/category exposure, channel absorption, realised price/mix, unit cost and working-capital conversion.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Industry production or broad retail growth can diverge from company sell-out, inventory, price capture and cash conversion.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Replacement-oriented refrigeration and washing demand is mediated by product freshness, channel/service execution, manufacturing cost and broader portfolio perimeter.
mechanism_arenas.customer_task: Household storage and laundry needs served by product, distribution, delivery and after-sales systems.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Category mix, product-cycle fit, service/logistics performance, cost and reinvestment requirements.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: A consolidated issuer's reported movement may reflect multi-business scope or acquisition/perimeter changes rather than a common white-goods mechanism.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Multi-category product, channel, service and consolidation boundaries can alter consolidated profit and cash independently of any single appliance category.
mechanism_arenas.customer_task: Not a homogeneous product-market claim; it records why issuer-level results need product and perimeter bridges.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Comparable responsibility boundary before inferring normal earnings, capital needs or owner-cash transmission.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Group cash, revenue or margin can be misattributed to a white-goods category without a product/perimeter bridge.

company_archetype_map.condition: The registered FY2016 issuer packet identifies a room-air-conditioner, channel, component and manufacturing-system research boundary; product sell-through, inventory and owner-cash conversion are not established by the block.

The registered FY2016–FY2017 issuer packets identify room air conditioning, refrigeration/washing and a multi-category channel/supply-chain boundary; acquisition and group-perimeter effects remain a required competing explanation.

The registered FY2016–FY2017 issuer packets identify refrigeration/washing, service and logistics mechanisms at the listed-consolidated boundary; global-acquisition and financing effects remain outside a domestic-appliance owner-cash conclusion.

The registered FY2016–FY2017 issuer packets identify room-air-conditioner and refrigeration/washing product, cost and inventory research threads; the block does not establish a same-boundary financing stress or owner-cash conclusion.

decision_heterogeneity_matrix.company_conditions: Room-air-conditioner exposure is recorded with channel, component and manufacturing interfaces.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.feasible_alternatives: Aggregate production can be absorbed differently across company channels and inventory positions.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.external_conditions: A national room-air-conditioner supply expansion is common context, not evidence of company sell-out or cash conversion.

decision_heterogeneity_matrix.company_conditions: A diversified appliance and supply-chain boundary is recorded across multiple white-goods arenas.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.feasible_alternatives: Portfolio/acquisition scope can explain consolidated change without a common product-market advantage.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.external_conditions: Broad retail growth does not settle category or channel capture at a multi-business issuer.

decision_heterogeneity_matrix.company_conditions: Refrigeration/washing, service and logistics interfaces are recorded at a global listed-consolidated boundary.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.feasible_alternatives: Global acquisition and financing effects can alter reported results independently of domestic white-goods transmission.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.external_conditions: Industry profit-pool growth may reach service/logistics systems differently from manufacturing-only exposure.

decision_heterogeneity_matrix.company_conditions: Dual white-goods product, cost and inventory research threads are recorded at the issuer boundary.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.feasible_alternatives: Reported category context cannot distinguish product/customer absorption from inventory or cost transmission.
decision_heterogeneity_matrix.external_conditions: A common supply/retail environment can create category exposure without a common cash or permanent-loss path.

conditional_mechanism_synthesis.when: Official context records broad retail growth, differing category production growth and aggregate industry profit-pool expansion before the Pack cutoff.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.decision: Industry context may frame a future thesis, but no issuer receives a common performance conclusion.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.mechanism: Broad retail, category production and aggregate profitability enter companies through different product portfolios, channels, service systems, cost/inventory positions and responsibility boundaries.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.observed_as: A source-backed research agenda for company-specific demand, price/mix, cost, working-capital, capital and owner-cash verification.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.unless: A same-period, same-product and same-responsibility-boundary company bridge establishes the required transmission.
conditional_mechanism_synthesis.counterexamples: Industry production, retail, revenue or profit growth may coexist with weak company sell-through, channel absorption, cash conversion or product-boundary comparability.

unresolved_questions.question: Which product/category, channel, realised-price or mix, unit-cost and working-capital fields show whether the official common environment enters this issuer's normal earnings and owner-cash path?
unresolved_questions.materiality: Without a same-boundary bridge, industry context cannot change normal earnings, owner cash, permanent-loss or valuation treatment.
unresolved_questions.next_evidence: Cutoff-safe annual-report or official disclosure locators for product/category exposure, customer/channel interface, operating/cash flow and capital/perimeter bridge.

unresolved_questions.question: Can the company product arena and responsibility boundary be held constant across the relevant period, especially for diversified or globally consolidated issuers?
unresolved_questions.materiality: A scope break can turn group movement into a false company or industry transmission signal.
unresolved_questions.next_evidence: Product/segment disclosure, acquisition/control bridge and same-boundary cash/capital fields.

next_sampling_decision.decision: Use a later test issuer only after the Pack stays separated from its identity and the target packet can answer the same company-transmission and boundary questions without importing Pack-side facts.
next_sampling_decision.rationale: The next case must discriminate whether the common environment changes a new company's economic treatment, rather than reward source familiarity or generic industry prose.
